learning_objective: 🎯 [Students will master the mechanics of converting sentences between active and passive voice across all tenses, and understand when to strategically use passive voice in formal and academic writing.]
warm_up_hook: 🎭 Who is the star of your sentence? Active voice puts the spotlight on the 'doer', while Passive voice flips the camera to the 'receiver'. Let's learn how to direct the action like a movie director! 🎬

lesson_modules.module_title: 🔄 The Core Flip: Subject to Object
lesson_modules.teaching_content: In Active Voice, the subject performs the action. In Passive Voice, the subject receives the action. To transform, move the object to the subject position, use the appropriate 'be' verb, add the past participle (V3) of the main verb, and add 'by [agent]'.
examples_or_templates: Active: The chef (Subject) cooks (Verb) the meal (Object).
Passive: The meal (Subject) is cooked (Be + V3) by the chef (Agent).

lesson_modules.teaching_content: The main verb always becomes a Past Participle (V3). The tense is carried by the 'be' verb (is/are, was/were, has been, is being, will be). Perfect continuous tenses and Future continuous are generally not changed into passive voice.
examples_or_templates: Present Continuous: 'They are building a house.' ➡️ 'A house is being built.'
Past Perfect: 'She had finished the work.' ➡️ 'The work had been finished by her.'

lesson_modules.module_title: ⚠️ Special Cases: Modals, Imperatives, and Two Objects
lesson_modules.teaching_content: Modals use 'modal + be + V3'. Imperative (command) sentences use 'Let + object + be + V3'. When a sentence has a direct and an indirect object, either can become the subject of the passive sentence.
examples_or_templates: Modal: 'You must pay the fine.' ➡️ 'The fine must be paid.'
Imperative: 'Open the door.' ➡️ 'Let the door be opened.'

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Choose the correct passive form: 'The mechanic is repairing my car.'
options: My car is repaired by the mechanic.
My car is being repaired by the mechanic.
My car was being repaired by the mechanic.
My car has been repaired by the mechanic.
practice_mcq_quiz.correct_answer: My car is being repaired by the mechanic.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Identify the sentence in the Active Voice:
options: The cake had been eaten before I arrived.
The committee approved the new budget.
The rules must be followed by everyone.
practice_mcq_quiz.correct_answer: The committee approved the new budget.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Change to passive voice: 'Who wrote this beautiful poem?'
subjective_practice.hint: Questions starting with 'Who' usually change to 'By whom' in the passive voice.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Change to passive voice using 'Let': 'Do not touch the exhibits.'
subjective_practice.hint: Follow the structure: Let + object + not be + past participle.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Change to active voice: 'The suspect was being interrogated by the detectives when the power went out.'
subjective_practice.hint: Identify the 'doer' (the detectives), determine the tense (past continuous), and flip the structure.

activity_or_assignment.title: 📰 The Neutral Journalist
activity_or_assignment.instructions: News reports often use passive voice to focus on the event rather than the person who did it. Write a 4-sentence 'breaking news' report about a bank robbery using ONLY passive voice (e.g., 'The bank was broken into at midnight...').

chapter_summary: ⭐ The core rule of passive voice is flipping the object to the subject and using a 'Be' verb + V3 (Past Participle).
⭐ The tense in a passive sentence is always indicated by the 'Be' helper verb, not the main verb.
⭐ Passive voice is essential for formal writing, especially when the 'doer' is unknown, obvious, or unimportant.
